title: Cinder Reverence — IMAX One-Sheet Title
description: A cinematic title-card template built on the visual grammar of prestige IMAX one-sheets — towering high-contrast serif logotype, tracked-out small-caps tagline, and a single ember-orange vein of light cutting through a desaturated atmospheric backdrop.
philosophy: This template exists for the moment that demands silence before it demands attention. It borrows from the Nolan and Villeneuve school of severe restraint: one color accent, one dominant type element, maximum negative space. It refuses decorative flourishes, multi-color hierarchies, and anything that dilutes the gravitational pull of the central image and title. It is for speakers who understand that awe is achieved by subtraction, not addition — and for rooms large enough to make a single bone-white serif feel like a monument.
goodFor: Epic product or film-announcement keynote openers
Event title cards and large-venue conference opening slides
3-line tagline compositions paired with a single full-bleed atmospheric photograph
Award ceremony category reveals and dramatic section dividers
avoidFor: Chart-heavy quarterly business reviews requiring multiple data panels
Light-branded corporate decks governed by bright, strict color guidelines
Step-by-step instructional or tutorial workshop decks with dense body copy
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide feels like the moment before a film begins — vast, pressurized silence broken only by a bone-white serif title emerging from a dark, desaturated atmospheric field. A single vein of warm amber-orange light cuts diagonally through the backdrop, the only chromatic event in an achromatic world. Bottom-weighted and monument-still, the upper canvas is surrendered entirely to negative space. Avoid decorative flourishes or any secondary color — the awe lives in what is withheld.

  <defs>

    <linearGradient id="vein" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">

      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#ed7a2a" stop-opacity="0.05"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#ed7a2a" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
      <stop offset="65%" stop-color="#ed7a2a" stop-opacity="0.05"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ed7a2a" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="veinCore" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ed7a2a" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="48%" stop-color="#fff0e0" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#fff0e0" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="52%" stop-color="#fff0e0" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ed7a2a" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="fadeBottom" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1a0f0a" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a0f0a" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="titleShade" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff0e0" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fff0e0" stop-opacity="0.88"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="grain" x="0%" y="0%" width="100%" height="100%">

  <ellipse cx="1240" cy="180" rx="500" ry="140" fill="#5a3a2a" opacity="0.12"/>

    <rect x="-400" y="355" width="2800" height="10" fill="url(#vein)"/>
    <rect x="-400" y="358" width="2800" height="3" fill="url(#veinCore)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Grain overlay -->

  <!-- Bottom vignette to seat the title -->
  <rect x="0" y="540" width="1920" height="540" fill="url(#fadeBottom)"/>

  <!-- Tiny top-left mark: format / release marker -->
  <g transform="translate(80,72)" fill="#fff0e0" opacity="0.55" font-family="ui-monospace, monospace" font-size="14" letter-spacing="3">
    <text x="0" y="0">PRESENTED IN</text>
    <text x="0" y="22" font-size="16" letter-spacing="6" font-weight="700">IMAX · 70MM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Tiny top-right mark: rating / date -->

    <text x="0" y="0">IN THEATRES</text>
    <text x="0" y="22" font-size="16" letter-spacing="6" font-weight="700">XII · MMXXVI</text>

  <!-- Pre-title eyebrow -->

  <!-- THE MONUMENT: title logotype -->
  <g font-family="Georgia, ui-serif, serif" text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="960" y="842" font-size="196" font-weight="400" fill="url(#titleShade)" letter-spacing="14">CINDER</text>
    <text x="960" y="842" font-size="196" font-weight="400" fill="none" stroke="#fff0e0" stroke-opacity="0.08" letter-spacing="14">CINDER</text>

  <g font-family="Georgia, ui-serif, serif" text-anchor="middle" font-style="italic">

  </g>

  <!-- Hairline rule -->
  <line x1="820" y1="968" x2="1100" y2="968" stroke="#fff0e0" stroke-opacity="0.45" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="960" cy="968" r="2.5" fill="#ed7a2a"/>

  <!-- Tracked small-caps tagline -->
  <g font-family="ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff0e0" opacity="0.78">
    <text x="960" y="1000" font-size="16" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="14">THE  FIRE  REMEMBERS  WHAT  THE  WORLD  FORGETS</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Lens safe-area hairlines (subtle, cinematic frame cue) -->

    <line x1="40" y1="40" x2="92" y2="40"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="40" x2="40" y2="92"/>
    <line x1="1880" y1="40" x2="1828" y2="40"/>
    <line x1="1880" y1="40" x2="1880" y2="92"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="1040" x2="92" y2="1040"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="1040" x2="40" y2="988"/>
    <line x1="1880" y1="1040" x2="1828" y2="1040"/>
    <line x1="1880" y1="1040" x2="1880" y2="988"/>

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed edge-to-edge backdrop with no outer margin band; the slide functions as a cinematic frame, not a document. Title logotype anchors in the lower-center third, spanning approximately cols 2–11 of a 12-col grid, with generous negative space above consuming roughly the top 60% of the canvas. A single tracked small-caps tagline sits immediately beneath the logotype, separated by a hairline rule. No slide number, no header band, no footer — compositional gravity lives entirely in the vertical lower stack.

examples.promptCore: This slide should feel like a single story beat inside a prestige film — one revelation surfacing from an atmospheric void rather than a listicle projected on a stage. All compositional gravity pools low, with the upper field left as breathing darkness that amplifies whatever emerges beneath it. A single slash of warm accent light — a rule line or one illuminated phrase — is the sole chromatic event against the desaturated backdrop. Resist bullet clusters, decorative boxing, or any second accent relationship; the severity itself is the aesthetic.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed atmospheric image runs edge-to-edge with no containing card or header band interrupting the field. A 12-column grid with 10% outer margins anchors the primary content block to cols 2–9, dropping it into the lower third of the canvas so the upper area remains pure open negative space. A single hairline rule in the accent color — placed between the dominant content element and any attribution or subline — acts as the slide's sole decorative intervention. Page folio sits bottom-right at the grid edge; no top bar, no logo lockup, no decorative frame around the content.
